senses.sense_definition: A small carnivorous mammal of the weasel family, native to Eurasia and North America, known for its long body and a tail with a black tip.

examples.text: The <w>stoat</w> is a clever hunter that often chases rabbits across the open fields.
During the winter, the <w>stoat</w> grows a thick white coat to blend in with the snow.
